maddeler.e:
تمتطوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَطُوا (tamtaṭū) /tam.ta.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# تُمْتَطَوْا (tumtaṭaw) /tum.ta.tˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
